selection_rule: Select every canonical feature whose geographic bounds intersect the candidate rectangle; preserve the canonical record byte-for-byte inside the pilot subset.
score_rule: score = 3 if building count is 2000-8000, +3 if all three height sources occur, +2 if classes >= 10, +2 if road classes >= 6, +2 if complex footprints >= 500, +2 if hole rings > 0, +2 if road records >= 5000; ties prefer more non-fallback heights, then more building classes.
